policies.title: Service runs privileged
policies.description: Checks that privileged is not true.
policies.rationale: A privileged container has nearly the host's power.
policies.remediation: Remove privileged and add specific capabilities.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    privileged: true
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    privileged: false

policies.title: Service mounts the Docker socket
policies.description: Checks that no volume maps a container runtime socket.
policies.rationale: Access to the socket is root on the host.
policies.remediation: Use a socket proxy with a narrow API allow-list if truly needed.
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    volumes:
      - data:/data

policies.title: Service uses the host network
policies.description: Checks that network_mode is not host.
policies.rationale: The container shares the host's network stack.
policies.remediation: Use published ports on a bridge network.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    network_mode: host
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    network_mode: bridge

policies.title: Service shares a host namespace
policies.description: Checks that pid, ipc, uts and userns_mode are not host.
policies.rationale: Sharing namespaces removes isolation from host processes or memory.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    pid: host
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    pid: service:other

policies.title: Service adds a powerful capability
policies.description: Checks that cap_add does not include ALL or near-root capabilities.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    cap_add:
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE

policies.title: Service does not drop capabilities
policies.absence_note: Without cap_drop the default capability set is kept: treated as a failure.
policies.remediation: Use cap_drop: [ALL] and add back what is required.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    restart: always
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    cap_drop:
      - ALL

policies.title: Database or Docker API port is published
policies.description: Checks that common data-store and Docker API ports are not published on the host.
policies.rationale: Published ports are reachable from outside the compose network.
policies.remediation: Do not publish them, or bind to 127.0.0.1.

policies.title: Service filesystem is writable
policies.rationale: A read-only root filesystem blocks many tampering techniques.
policies.absence_note: Default is writable: treated as a failure.
policies.remediation: Set read_only: true and use tmpfs/volumes for writable paths.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    restart: always
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    read_only: true

policies.title: Service runs as root
policies.description: Checks that user is not root.
policies.rationale: Root inside the container makes bugs more costly.
policies.absence_note: No user: the image's USER applies and is not visible here: result is unknown.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    user: root

policies.title: Service disables a security profile
policies.description: Checks that seccomp/AppArmor/SELinux confinement is not disabled.
policies.rationale: These profiles are the default safety net.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true

policies.title: A literal secret is set in the environment
policies.description: Checks that secret-like environment names have no inline value (list or map form).
policies.rationale: Inline secrets end up in version control.
policies.remediation: Use env_file kept out of version control, or Docker secrets.
policies.positive:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    environment:
      - DB_PASSWORD=hunter2
policies.negative:
services:
  web:
    image: app:1.0
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=db

policies.title: Service image uses latest or no tag
policies.description: Checks that images have an explicit non-latest tag.
policies.remediation: Pin a version tag or digest.
